articles.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog announced Saturday that he will give former military chief Gadi Eisenkot the first opportunity to form Israel's next government, handing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu a significant political setback nearly two weeks after the country's parliamentary elections.

articles.title: New Zealand election cliffhanger with major parties left deadlocked but new centrist Opportunity party could be kingmakers
articles.summary: Overnight results showed the ruling centre-right National Party and main opposition Labour Party were nearly deadlocked in the popular vote.

articles.title: New Zealand’s Election ‘Too Close to Call’ as Voters Turn to Minor Parties
